dataset.dataset_grain: One public loan/application record (unique identifier not provided in public schema)
dataset.documentation_scope: Published public LAR field reference, which currently lists activity years 2017-2025
dataset.source_encoding_assumption: All CSV input columns read as strings to preserve public codes, leading zero identifiers, and text sentinels
dataset.null_token_caution: Treat empty string as a null-like token for profiling only. Never globally convert NA, Exempt, 1111, 8888, 9999, or 0 to NULL.
dataset.key_policy: No unique row key assumed; do not treat LEI as row-level unique.
dataset.default_violations_policy: Quarantine bad records or report and continue; configure according to stage and check severity

decoding_policy.behavior: Keep source code unchanged; decode into a separate derived column or use lookup at query time.
decoding_policy.scope: Every field with allowed_values has a complete code-to-description mapping, including already-human-readable categories and special values.
decoding_policy.interpretation_note: Exact display text and accepted codes are reporting-year dependent; confirm against the applicable annual HMDA guide.

dataset_rules.description: Verify all columns from the selected schema are present.
Report unexpected columns; upstream version changes may occur.
The landed file must contain at least one row; adjust for intentionally empty slices.
Legal Entity Identifiers are conventionally 20 characters; confirm annual data exceptions before hard enforcement.
Publication-years allow-list is version-specific, not future-proof.
Validate parsing only; business range check requires verified conditions.
Compare derived_loan_product_type with loan_type + lien_status, after confirming rule behavior for dataset year.
Compare derived_dwelling_category with construction_method + total_units, after checking relevant public category encodings.
Report exact duplicate rows, not guaranteed logical duplicate loans.
